txt_en: Flags rise because someone once refused to kneel.
txt_cn: 旗帜升起，因为曾有人拒绝跪下。

txt_en: October is a symphony of permanence and change.
txt_cn: 十月是一首关于永恒与改变的交响曲。

txt_en: Tears are words that need to be written.
txt_cn: 眼泪是需要被写下的文字。

txt_en: A ship in harbor is safe, but that is not what ships are built for.
txt_cn: 船泊港湾固然安全，但那不是造船的目的。

txt_en: We are all just prisoners of our own random thoughts.
txt_cn: 我们都只是自己飘忽思绪的囚徒。

txt_en: Keep a little fire burning, however small, however hidden.
txt_cn: 让一小簇火焰继续燃烧，无论多微弱，无论多隐秘。

txt_en: It is a brutal thing to be loved without knowing it.
txt_cn: 被人所爱却浑然不觉，是一件残酷的事。

txt_en: Every leaf speaks bliss to me, fluttering from the autumn tree.
txt_cn: 每一片离枝的秋叶，都对我说着幸福的话语。

txt_en: The quieter you become, the more you are able to hear.
txt_cn: 你越安静，能听到的就越多。

txt_en: The marrow of our bones remembers what our minds have tried to forget.
txt_cn: 我们骨髓深处记得那些大脑试图遗忘的东西。

txt_en: I'm not scared of death, I'm scared of not having lived.
txt_cn: 我不怕死亡，我怕的是没有真正活过。

txt_en: If you look for perfection, you'll never be content.
txt_cn: 如果你追求完美，你将永远无法满足。

txt_en: You must never be fearful about what you are doing when it is right.
txt_cn: 当你做的是正确的事时，绝不要害怕。

txt_en: You were born to break out of the box they put you in.
txt_cn: 你生来就是要冲破他人给你设下的条条框框。

txt_en: I would always rather be happy than dignified.
txt_cn: 我宁愿快乐，也不愿体面。

txt_en: I pick up the pieces of my broken heart and make a mosaic.
txt_cn: 我拾起破碎之心的碎片，把它做成一幅马赛克拼贴画。

txt_en: The nameless people are the ones who carry the world on their backs.
txt_cn: 无名之辈，正是以脊背托起世界的人。

txt_en: We climb not to escape the world but to see it whole.
txt_cn: 我们登高，不是为了逃离世界，而是为了看见它的全貌。

txt_en: Nature was here something savage and awful, though beautiful.
txt_cn: 这里的大自然虽美，却也野性十足，令人畏惧。

txt_en: Although the world is full of suffering, it is full also of the overcoming of it.
txt_cn: 世界虽然充满苦难，但也充满了对苦难的克服。

txt_en: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given us.
txt_cn: 我们所要决定的，就是如何利用给予我们的时间。

txt_en: Words are, of course, the most powerful drug used by mankind.
txt_cn: 语言当然是人类所使用的最强效的药物。

txt_en: Happiness cannot be pursued, it must ensue.
txt_cn: 幸福不可强求，只能随之而生。

txt_en: Those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it.
txt_cn: 不能铭记过去的人，注定要重蹈覆辙。

txt_en: The heart is an arrow, it demands aim to land true.
txt_cn: 人心如箭，唯有认准方向，才能抵达所向之处。

txt_en: You belong everywhere you dream of.
txt_cn: 你属于你梦到的每一个地方

txt_en: Home is where the heart is.
txt_cn: 心在哪里，家就在哪里。
